description: Run the requests defined in the endpoint YAML files against the running API and check the responses. Returns a report: summary counts and one result per test; each failure has `check`, `path`, `expected`, `actual`, a one-line `message`, and the handler `source` (file:line) so you can jump to the code. The server under test must already be running at the environment's base_url. A failing test is reported in the result (ok=false), not as a tool error.

base_url.description: Override the environment base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080.

filter.description: Only run endpoints/tests whose id, file or test name contains this text, e.g. `users.create`.

smoke_unsafe.description: Also send the implicit smoke request to endpoints without tests whose method may change data (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE). Off by default; do not enable against shared or production environments.

update_snapshots.description: Overwrite stored snapshots with the actual responses. Only use when the new behaviour is intended.

name: test
